info.name: Oracle EBS Manufacturing API
info.description:
RESTful APIs for Oracle E-Business Suite manufacturing modules including Bills of Material (BOM), Work in Process (WIP), and Work Orders. Provides programmatic access to manufacturing execution and planning functions deployed as REST services through the Integrated SOA Gateway.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Support
 Email: support@oracle.com
